node-1.label: Woman in her 20s presented with well-demarcated hand dermatitis on the left and right third fingers

node-2.label: The dermatitis was recalcitrant and unresponsive to topical medications including corticosteroids

node-3.label: Medical history was remarkable for 'eczema' dating back to childhood; patch testing results were negative

node-4.label: Physical examination showed sharply demarcated erythematous scaly plaques with fissures, scale crust, and nail pitting on the left and right third fingers; the left third finger was confluently covered while the rest of the hand was unaffected
